title: Attack on Mallworld? Anyone experience something similar to this?
content: I dreamed about this in the morning. Somewhere between the hours of 8am to 11am central time in the U.S. Any way I dreamed the mall was going to be attacked by a coordinated group of people. A gang? A terrorist group? I don't know. It started out with me being in a school with a group of others. Maybe 30 or so people between the ages of 20 to around 60 years old. I was sitting down with a younger group and started to get a bad feeling. Like something is wrong. Something was off. I then started to ask several of the people around me if they knew how to defend themselves. If they knew how to use guns and other weapons. I asked a few women first, then some men. I ended up having a team of 6 people, including me. 4 men and 2 women. The 3 men I knew from work. The two women were celebrities. I don't know why I even dreamed about one of these. I can guess why the other appeared. One of the women was Nina Dobrev from the old Vampire Diaries tv show. Don't know why, she was just there. The other was Ariana Grande. But this might have been cuz I had just seen some new SNL clips that she was in. Either way, they were all armed and ready to fight. We started to hear explosions and yelling. I looked out the door and spotted some buildings on fire and smoke everywhere. I closed the door and told everyone to line up against a wall. I ran and looked out a window. I spotted a familiar tower from a past dream above what I figured had to be the mall, and a hospital below us. Everyone else were lying on the floor. We ran to another door and exited out the building. We were in what looked like an area for trucks to drop off merchandise. A receiving area. As we came out here, a group of kids in their early teens came out from behind a truck and caught us by surprise. Now usually whenever I've had dreams about being in danger like this, I suddenly have these Jedi-like powers. But I was relying more on our guns. Those kids were also pointing guns at us. There was smoke all around and fire on some of the nearby buildings. There an explosion somewhere that caused the kids to look away. That's when Ariana and one of the guys started to open fire at them. They were all taken out. Ok....good work I guess. But we made out way out to the parking lot. Only it was a war zone. People were using cars as barriers from gunfire. For some reason we decided that we needed to get back into a part of the mall. It looked like it was the part that looked like it was straight out of the 80s. Somehow as we ran to the entrance of the mall, we managed to avoid getting hit. But it seemed like we managed to kill some of the enemy. I remember looking back at the tower and just like the previous dream it was in, there were people way up there looking down at us. Just like before, they seemed to be wearing lab coats. When we got inside the mall, we found out that two of the guys had been killed somehow. I don't remember seeing them get shot. For some reason, Ariana and the last guy said we had to get to security and tell them about more attacks that were coming. That what just happened was a test and the real attack was coming soon. Anyone ever been in the mall or surrounding areas while being attacked by normal looking people there were not military looking. just plain clothed people who decided that they wanted to bring the place down. By the looks of it the mall was being defended by other normal looking people. I don't why but people were fighting against each other.
